title: `concepts/parfit-reductionism` zombie argument and ontology — L59 says a "zombie duplicate" "would satisfy Parfit's criteria for identity (physical and psychological continuity)" (a duplicate stands in no continuity relation to you), L142 "Zombie conceivability shows identity involves something beyond continuity" is unhedged against personal-identity L95, L55 "agents cause actions as persisting substances" against process haecceitism, L123 "'you' could be continued by any replica" ignores the non-branching clause
